caption: The drawing features a vertically oriented, oval-shaped object with ornate, symmetrical filigree patterns and scrollwork at the top and bottom. In the center of the object, there are two horizontal, solid bands; the upper band contains the text "RICHMOND" and the lower band has the letters "CAL," both in uppercase. The filigree consists of scrolling, leaf-like forms, and a central vertical support runs through the middle, dividing the design. The object is rendered in shades of dark brown, giving it the appearance of wrought iron or metal. The background is a plain light beige or off-white, with no additional elements. In the lower right corner, the name “ROSE CAMPBELL CETNR” is printed in small, spaced-out capital letters.
title: Flatiron Stand
